watches.name: THE SLIM - NO SIGNAL
watches.description: Available Quantity: 20 Pcs. REMEMBER THIS SCREEN? Before streaming, there was static. The program ended, the picture disappeared, and suddenly the screen was all colour bars, hissing snow and beautifully bad reception . Somehow, the interruption became part of the show. NO SIGNAL brings that moment back, then turns the volume up. The dial is a collision of everything we miss about ’90s visual culture: a tiny retro television broadcasting colour bars at 7 o’clock, black-and-white static scattered across the background, electric pink and yellow zigzags, hypnotic spirals, comic-book bursts and oversized geometric shapes. Busy on purpose. Loud by design. Rather than sitting flat on the surface, the graphics are brought to life through 3D printing , creating layers of texture and depth across the dial. As the light and viewing angle change, different details jump forward, while the polished hands slice cleanly through the visual noise. Then comes the contrast. All that graphic chaos lives inside an incredibly sleek 4.9mm stainless steel case , flowing directly into a vertically brushed integrated bracelet. From the front, it refuses to be ignored. From the side, it almost disappears. Loud dial. Quiet profile. 90s noise. 4.9mm thin. A little static. A lot of personality. And once NO SIGNAL goes off air, there are no reruns. Limited Release.

watches.description: Designed for both modern men and women, the Terra Daybreak Suede sports a tartaruga (tortoise) shaped case, an UNDONE’s first, at just 37mm wide. The watch comes with a 2-colored lume - its 12-hour numbers illuminate in blue, while the thick indices markers, the iconic triangle (for easy identification) at 12 o’clock, and the hour & minute hands light up in green under low-light conditions. The Terra Daybreak Suede comes with a light brown suede strap. Housed within the scratch-resistant sapphire crystal is a Japanese TMI NH35A Automatic Winding Mechanism with a 42-hour power reserve.

Inspired by the elegant power of manta rays gliding through Japan’s Kuroshio Current, the Aqua Carbon Maggy is more than a watch, it’s a statement. The 40mm size is the perfect balance of vintage-inspired design and modern wearability. The Japanese TMI VK61 Mechanical-Quartz Hybrid Flyback Chronograph ensures accurate timekeeping, while the 12-month warranty provides peace of mind. Wear the Urban Vintage Tuxedo Gold and feel confident and stylish no matter where you go. This is not just a watch, it's an extension of your personality and sense of style.

watches.name: Chinese Hour Snake | Black

Popeye™ stands proud at the center of the dial in his classic, gruff persona, one eye squinting, corn-cob pipe tooting, and his comically muscular arms ingeniously serving as the hour and minute hands. The black leather strap with white stitching enhances the vintage-inspired design, delivering a refined contrast that elevates its overall appeal. A perfect blend of nostalgia and contemporary style, this limited-edition watch is a must-have for collectors and fans alike.

watches.name: UNDONE × The Hokusai-kan Museum | The Wave Forward

This unique collaboration not only highlights UNDONE’s commitment to craftsmanship but also pays homage to the timeless beauty of Hokusai’s artwork, making this a true collector’s piece for both watch enthusiasts and art lovers alike.

watches.name: Urban Automatic Sandstorm

watches.name: Urban Automatic Eclipse
watches.description: Get the best of both worlds with the Urban Automatic Eclipse watch. Featuring a vintage look and modern automatic movement, it's the perfect balance of old and new. Don't miss out on its triple calendar dials and sleek black design. Upgrade your style today!

The dial features Sanrio characters rocking a “Hello Kitty Hat” and a cute disc-shaped second hand shaped with Hello Kitty soaring through the air. Flip it over to see a special 50th-anniversary design on the case back. And here’s a fun twist: in the dark, the whole dial lights up in blue, making it not only stylish but easy to see!

watches.name: Basecamp Cali Black Automatic

Say hello to your newest old-school mechanical tool watch, in classic black or khaki green.

watches.name: Vintage Mystique Eclipse
watches.description: Artisanal Dress Watch Sensual, seductive and sublime. Let the gorgeous ombre hues of this smoky 40mm dress timepiece reflect your mood. Its elegant green fume dial is carefully crafted in our lab through 12 labour-intensive steps, resulting in a classic watch under 300 USD: the type of watch to wear with a suit, when grown-ups come out to play.

watches.name: Basecamp Collector
watches.description: Made for Boundless Exploration From city streets to rugged trails, the Basecamp Collector is designed for modern adventurers. Engineered with precision, its robust NH34 GMT automatic movement delivers flawless timekeeping on your wildest adventures. Crafted from aerospace-grade titanium, the same material designed for spacecraft and elite jets—this watch offers unparalleled strength in an extraordinarily lightweight form, enabling you to conquer both the ocean's abyss and the city's heights with ease. The Basecamp Collector isn't just built to last, it's designed to inspire. Its sleek case and crystal-clear sapphire lens are more than mere components, they are the culmination of relentless innovation and enduring craftsmanship. With water resistance up to 100 meters (10ATM), it stands as your reliable partner through plunging oceanic explorations and the relentless pace of urban life, proving that true exploration knows no boundaries

watches.name: Aquadeep Signal Yellow Automatic

watches.name: Vintage Tuxedo
watches.description: Retro Dress Watch Looking for the best vintage watch without the vintage Chrono price tag? Look no further. Inspired by some of the most iconic timepieces of the century, these trendy 40mm mecha-quartz beauties are your handshake with history.

watches.name: Urban 34 Killy Grey Sterling For Her

watches.description: The limited edition Terra RED EDITION features a mysterious and stylish 37mm case complemented by a black and red colorway. The Terra RED EDITION is thoughtfully designed to resonate with the modern language of watch design, and is perfect for the streets at any time of the day. The watch's 12-hour numbers, index markers, and hour and minute hands feature a green lume for outstanding visibility in low light conditions. Housed within the scratch-resistant sapphire crystal is a Japanese TMI NH35A Automatic Winding Mechanism with a 42-hour power reserve.

watches.name: Aero Commando
watches.description: YOUR EVERYDAY AVIATION WATCH Are you looking for a watch to guide you on your flights? Let us introduce this 40mm stainless steel, vintage aviation watch. The sandblasted treatment of the black finishing lends the black an extra dimension; adding depth to the highly legible Arabic hour marker. The UNDONE Aero - Commando offers a modern aesthetic for such a classic watch. Relive an important era in watchmaking, with this tribute to the first-ever rotating bezel; invented by P.V.H Weems.

watches.name: Aero Worldtimer "Lindbergh"
watches.description: A TIMEPIECE FOR THE MODERN DAY JETSETTER Relive the sense of wonder, daring and spirit of innovation shared by pilots, engineers, watchmakers & travellers of our yesteryears, who propelled technology in flight & watch making beyond just blueprints and promises from the future. The AERO Worldtimer extends its tribute to Weems beyond his important design by introduces the classic Worldtimer functionality among the new AERO collection’s retro-futuristic makeover…

watches.name: Urban 34 Valentine's special edition
watches.description: As Valentine's Day approaches, the clock is ticking, and anticipation is in the air. They say if you can't give her the moon, give her the stars with our starry midnight black dial . Get her the perfect gift with this timeless gift, a functional companion for your romantic journey. The watch seamlessly blends sophistication and romance with a reliable Japanese-made VH31 Quartz movement. The watch comes with two straps for the price of one, featuring interchangeable black Epsom grained leather straps effortlessly transitioning from day to night. The compact and elegant variation of our popular Urban collection case, with a 34mm size and hardened domed K1 crystal ensures durability for everyday wear. Ditch the roses this Valentine, this UNDONE watch design is as unique as her.

watches.name: Aquadeep Submerge Automatic
watches.description: Introducing the UNDONE Aquadeep, a diver's watch built for the abyss. Its precision engineering & a robust NH36 automatic movement ensure accurate timekeeping for the duration of any mission beneath the waves. Crafted from lightweight yet durable Titanium, it's designed for ultra-deep dives without the burden of weight. Thanks to its helium escape valve & screw-down crown, the Aquadeep excels all the way up to 500 m of depth (50 ATM). Its jet-black sandblasted finish work to balance out its extremely rugged design. Dive down to the ocean floor with the Submerge – a pairing of precision and endurance for the highest pressure environments.

watches.name: Basecamp Quest
watches.description: Craft your legend with the UNDONE Basecamp Quest, a bronze beacon of time designed to uniquely bear the marks of your adventures. As it ages, its patina unfolds a rich palette of blues, browns, and reds, each hue a chapter of your story. Compact in design yet grand in its journey, it features a 40mm stainless steel case and a durable LEXAN Polycarbonate lens. At its heart beats the reliable NH34 GMT Automatic Movement, offering precision and global time-telling capability. With 10 ATM water resistance, this watch is an enduring partner to the modern explorer.

watches.name: Type 20 Special Edition
watches.description: I conic Pilot Watch Our ''Special Edition'' is its 21st-century renaissance. Big-eye sub-dials in its center console glow a neoteric blue, while its chassis is PVD-coated satin black.

watches.name: Sport Newman
watches.description: The UNDONE Newman, inspired by the legendary Paul Newman, boasts a striking panda dial not only for style but also for clear visibility. Its tachymeter bezel isn't just a nod to racing heritage; it's a functional tool to gauge velocity in the fast lane of life. In the spirit of Newman's passion for precision and speed, this watch is designed for those who appreciate the elegance of the past while racing towards the future. Whether you're timing laps or simply enjoying the moment, the UNDONE Newman is your companion for every victory, large or small, on and off the track.

watches.name: Ronin Automatic
watches.description: Inspired by the ancient Japanese legend “Revenge of the 47 Rōnin” and the renegade romantics of modern Bōsōzoku biker culture - the UNDONE Ronin is a watch forged for the latter day samurais and adrenaline junkies of our dystopian age. The original story follows a band of renegade Samurai who defied all law and circumstance to avenge the wrongful death of their master, even if it meant certain death upon themselves; their vendetta would go down as one of the most dramatic and bloody episodes in Japanese history and is considered a tale emblematic of the noble samurai virtues of loyalty, courage and sacrifice long lost to a bygone era...

watches.name: Basecamp Stealth Automatic
watches.description: The Basecamp Stealth is a testament to the power of minimalist design paired with uncompromising functionality. This watch embraces the understated elegance of black, offering a bold yet refined statement on the wrist. Crafted for adaptability, the Stealth is as at home in the urban jungle as it is on a mountain trail, making it a perfect choice for the adventurer who doesn’t compromise on style. With its durable build and the sophisticated, stealth-inspired aesthetics, it strikes the perfect balance between resilience and urban chic.

watches.name: Mr. Bones
watches.description: A Skele-Fun Tick Tock! Say hello to Mr. Bones, your ghostly companion guiding you through the tick-tocks with a whimsical wiggle and a skeletal smile! It’s not just a watch; it’s a bony buddy offering timeless adventures, one tick at a time!

watches.name: AquaLume Automatic
watches.description: Expected Delivery Date: Starting from Early February , shipped in sequence. "Life's a beach!" But why frolic in the shallows when you can dive into the deep blue yonder with the AquaLume? Equipped with a luminous dial that's designed to illuminate the unexplored depths. This isn't just a timepiece; it's your trusty co-adventurer, built for those who prefer Neptune's kingdom over terra firma. With a staggering 500m depth capacity, AquaLume shatters boundaries and lights up your way into the mysterious aquatic world, because who wants limitations when there's so much to explore?

watches.name: The UNDONE Shunga: Meiji
watches.description: TOY OF THE HIGH SOCIETY The UNDONE Nippon Erotica: Shunga Collection is a reinterpretation of the erotic watch aesthetic that was indicative of the high-society in the 17th century. After so many years, it is still sought after in this present day and age. The Shunga: Meiji features a modern Shunga painting on the dial without showcasing anything explicit. Turn the piece around and you will be met with the “practical” part of the watch, the full scene of a pair engaging in coitus with a glimpse of the movement behind the patterned glass caseback. The dial is finished with " 當世風俗通 "(the Ukiyo custom of pleasure-seeking) just below 12 o’clock and " 春 " (Shunga) meaning the picture of spring, a euphemism of sex, on the chronograph counter located at 9:00. Exuding a more modern and industrial vibe, Shunga: Meiji comes with a navy blue strap that matches the dial of the watch. UNDONE Shunga: Meiji is limited to only 300 pieces , with each uniquely serialized. Featuring two dial designs that span across hundreds of years, also explore the Shunga: Edo , a traditional version of the Shunga art.

The simple friendship between an alien and innocent children resonates strongly with imaginative souls all over the world. [Limited to 100PCS only]

watches.name: UNDONE | BLOCKBUSTER: CASPER THE FRIENDLY GHOST
watches.description: UNDONE launches the UNIVERSAL “BLOCKBUSTER” series, bringing much-anticipated news to wristwatches and movie fanatics. This highly collectible watch series captures the collective imagination of great minds behind instant classics such as the likes of “Back To The Future”, “ET” (The Extra-Terrestrial), “Casper the Friendly Ghost”, Jurassic World and JAWS. [Limited to 100PCS only]

watches.name: POPEYE & FRIENDS AQUA Brutus Limited Edition Automatic
watches.description: While Brutus floats alluringly on a transparent dial; it at the same time reveals the inner details of the mechanical movement. The key feature to this tough guy’s divers case is the hard PVD coating that has a hardness in excess of stainless steel, and in a deep color of blue that is difficult to achieve with great evenness. This watch also features an ultra thick sapphire crystal with inner anti-reflective treatment to increase visibility in sunlight. The Black Zirconium Dioxide (ZrO2) ceramic bezel insert also makes it almost impossible to scratch under normal circumstances. This watch is limited to only 150 pieces, with every piece serialized on the watch caseback.

watches.name: POPEYE & FRIENDS “Destro” Popeye Limited Edition Automatic
watches.description: The Sailor Man watch with snowflake markers in this natural bronze case has a special ability to quickly develop a patina on the outer layer, making each look unique and aged. One may not readily realize that Popeye always uses his left hand to hold his spinach can. This limited edition has a left hand crown setup, which is a rare feature in a watch. It not only caters to “lefties” who wear their watches on the right hand, but also for those who wear watches on their left hand yet prefer the crown not to intrude onto the wrist. This watch is limited to only 250 pieces, with every piece serialized on the watch caseback.

watches.name: UNDONE x Kevin Lyons Customizable Monsters
watches.description: UNDONE comes together with one of the world’s most prolific street artists, Kevin Lyons, for a unique monstrous collection showcasing. Lyons’ artwork and Monsters have appeared worldwide from New York to Paris to Japan, from murals to backpacks to snowboards, and now to your wrist. As a creative director and artist, Kevin Lyons has worked with the biggest streetwear and sportswear names, including Nike, Converse, adidas, Burton Snowboards, Stüssy, Vans, and many more. The “UNDONE x Kevin Lyons Customizable Monsters” explores Lyons’ emotions as experienced in relation to time. In true UNDONE fashion, you will be able to customize your piece from six clever phrases about time that can be mix-and-matched with one of six of his signature Monsters—leaving you with endless combinations to pick from. Well, thirty-six, to be exact.

watches.name: Terra Daybreak Automatic
watches.description: Designed for both modern men and women, the Terra Daybreak sports a tartaruga (tortoise) shaped case, an UNDONE’s first, at just 37mm wide. The watch comes with a 2-colored lume - its 12-hour numbers illuminate in blue, while the thick indices markers, the iconic triangle (for easy identification) at 12 o’clock, and the hour & minute hands light up in green under low-light conditions. The Terra Daybreak Suede comes with a light brown suede strap. Housed within the scratch-resistant sapphire crystal is a Japanese TMI NH35A Automatic Winding Mechanism with a 42-hour power reserve.

watches.name: Terra II Blue Lagoon Automatic
watches.description: The UNDONE TERRA “Surf and Turf” collection is a playful take on the colours of that long-overdue getaway. UNDONE pays tribute to the classic ‘Grenade Dial’ with an homage that looks to take you (by the wrist) far from home. The choice of aquatic/continental colours lends a map-like narrative to the enigmatic lines of this classic waffle design.

watches.description: Sensual, seductive and sublime. Let the gorgeous ombré hues of this smoky 40mm dress timepiece reflect your mood – are you more like Neptune or Mercury, or perhaps an Eclipse? Its elegant fumé dial is carefully crafted in our lab through 12 labour-intensive steps, resulting in a classic watch under 300 USD: the type of watch to wear with a suit, when grown-ups come out to play.

watches.name: UNDONE X POPEYE™ "SEAWEED"
watches.description: Featuring the most sought-after colors of 2021 among watch collectors, this character watch highlights an emerald green dial/bezel combination with a golden case to bring forth a distinguished sense of vintage harmony. Popeye™ himself stands proud in the middle of the dial in his well-loved gruff – one-eye squinting, corn-cob pipe tooting demeanour – with his comically muscular arms serving as the functioning hours and minutes hands. Surrounding the luxurious green dial is a bi-directional rotating bezel with beige diver function numerals to measure any time-related events. The watch is paired with a green leather strap for a distinct vintage vibe.

watches.name: Undone 420 Cali Automatic
watches.description: An entire month dedicated to puffing and passing? We say “hell yes!”. Initially an April Fool’s joke, it’s now here to stay! This automatic watch has 0% THC and CBD but 100% of the original flavor. Characterized by its unmistakable green colors on a California dial and accentuated by the “devil’s lettuce” on the 12-hour mark, as well as a cheeky “4” at the 20-minute mark (get it?), this watch is dedicated to puffers and watch collectors alike. What’s more, you can now customize the 420 Cali with your initials or a caseback photo to make that the only one in the world!

watches.name: UNDONE Disney Pinocchio Terra GMT Automatic
watches.description: Crafted with the same passion and determination as the small wooden puppet it's inspired by, the Undone Disney Pinocchio Terra GMT is a reminder that anything is possible when you chase your dreams. With a unique printed Pinocchio character, an unconventional California dial, and the capability to track two time zones, this watch is perfect for those who dare to dream and stand out from the crowd. The robust Japanese TMI NH34 automatic movement powers the watch for reliable, accurate timekeeping, and the vintage-sized 37mm Terra case with a tartaruga-shaped design ensures comfort and style. Add some charm and personality to your look with the delightful Pinocchio character and the Jiminy Cricket-tipped GMT hand.

watches.name: UNDONE Disney Donald Terra GMT Automatic
watches.description: Inspired by one of the most beloved and iconic Disney characters, the Undone Disney Donald Terra GMT is a true standout among watches. Featuring a unique sector dial in a bold navy blue color, this watch captures the adventurous and mischievous spirit of Donald Duck himself. With a reliable Japanese TMI NH34 automatic movement, you can trust that this watch will keep accurate time no matter where your adventures take you. And for those who need to keep track of multiple time zones, the GMT function with a whimsical Chip N Dale-tipped hand has you covered. Add a touch of charm to your look with the delightful duo, and stand out from the crowd with the distinctive design of this must-have timepiece.

watches.name: Undone Disney Space Legend Black Chronograph Customizable
watches.description: UNDONE's Space Legend Chronograph pays homage to the Apollo-Soyuz Test Project and Disney's magic. The matte black dial, with bi-compax layout, rocket ship logo, and Mickey Mouse in his red-striped spacesuit on the 60-minute subdial at 9 o'clock, is a perfect combination. The Japanese TMI VK64 mechanical-quartz hybrid flyback chronograph movement powers the watch, ensuring its reliability and accuracy. A hardened domed K1 mineral glass, pump-style chronograph pushers, and a large onion-shaped crown add to the watch's durability and functionality. With 30 meters of water resistance, it is suitable for everyday wear. The UNDONE Space Legend Chronograph is customizable with five different Disney characters, each with its corresponding caseback, making it unique to you. The distinctive design and high-quality components make it the perfect accessory for those who appreciate a hint of Disney magic and the enduring spirit of space exploration.

watches.name: Basecamp Classic Blackout Automatic
watches.description: A gutsy, good-looking tool watch that combines high-performance functionality with vintage aesthetics. Featuring an iconic orange hour hand, ultra-domed plexi crystal, sterile bezel and black NATO strap, this 40mm UNDONE Basecamp “Blackout” is designed with the style, comfort and durability for everyday wear. Yes, you may have found the best affordable automatic watch under 500 USD out there!

watches.name: Vintage Salmon
watches.description: Amidst the rising horological frenzy over all things vintage and esoteric, such as the stellar spectacle of Tiffany and her 6 million dollar blue; another particular pick of pastel: “Salmon Pink”, makes a cyclical comeback from obscurity and into contemporary reverence. Introducing the UNDONE Urban Salmon- a portrait of all the signature elements that lend these classic dials that unmistakable air of class & nuance, rich with details telling of heritage and deliberate design.

watches.name: Basecamp Cali GREEN Automatic
watches.description: On the hunt for an affordable automatic watch under 500 USD with a truly vintage feel? Let us introduce this 40mm daily watch. UNDONE Cali models flaunt the distinct California dial, a design that dates back to the 1930s, and comprises Roman numerals on top, and Arabic ones below. Say hello to your newest old-school mechanical tool watch, in classic black or khaki green.

watches.name: Basecamp Cali Bronze Automatic
watches.description: A unique horological experiment that features Bronze not only as a case material, but as an instrument of intrigue and introspection on the subject of life, death and rebirth. No two bronze pieces patina the same, the end result being contingent on the material’s interaction with its environment in which it is immersed, the natural or anthropic processes it goes through over the passage of time. The patina varies widely giving unique characteristics that enhance the beauty of the product much like the effects of different adversities in life has on different individuals.

watches.name: Vintage Killy
watches.description: Looking for the best vintage watch without the vintage chrono price tag? Look no further. Inspired by some of the most iconic timepieces of the century, these trendy 40mm mecha-quartz beauties are your handshake with history. A timeless testament to the “golden age” of watchmaking, the UNDONE Killy is the affordable everyday watch you’ve always wanted to wield on your wrist.

watches.name: UNDONE DISNEY SPACE LEGEND BOX SET Automatic
watches.description: UNDONE introduces a limited edition box set of time instruments for the wannabe space legend inside all of us. The UNDONE Disney Space Legend box set celebrates an iconic Disney World moment in 1975 where Mickey Mouse greeted both astronauts and cosmonauts enroute to tour the Kennedy Space Center in Florida. This bundled set of 100 limited units comes with three unique timepieces cased in a waterproof and shockproof box. For the technical time teller we offer “Soyuz”, space tech tri-compax mechaquartz flyback chronograph with carbon-fiber bezel, galaxy lume dial and a mission ready nato style strap. Next up the “Apollo”, powered by Japanese automatic movement, topped with ultra-dome K1 lens bringing our signature galaxy lume dial into full perspective. Last but not least, a “Mission Timer” clock that can stay in the cockpit or mission control centre. The kit comes with a set of high quality collectible stickers featuring Mickey, Donald, Goofy, Pluto and Chip ‘N Dale in full space suit gear.

watches.name: UNDONE X POPEYE™ "Arabian Knight" Automatic
watches.description: UNDONE introduces: UNDONE x Popeye I The Arabian Knight- Everyone’s favourite one eye squinting, spinach chewing sailorman swaps out his old corncob pipe for the more philosophical shisha hookah and sets off into the desert sea looking for answers. With the help of the Popeye, UNDONE revisits its gemstoned inspired reflection on the ephemerality of the human condition, as expressed poetically in this timeless Persian adage.

watches.name: UNDONE Disney Mickey collection “Guess Who’s Back” Automatic
watches.description: Since the first pen strokes of a whistling mouse aboard an old steamboat in 1928, Mickey Mouse has since then sailed steadily into the fond public consciousness with his big white gloves & funny shoes. While the famous mouse has gone through numerous makeover eversince… his round floppy ears, his iconic shades of black, red and yellow remain synonymous with the technicolour joy he has brought onto the lives and television sets of families around the world. This endearing collector’s piece seeks to celebrate his vibrant mousey antics, by bringing it onto your wrist in a fun and lighthearted way. **Exclusive to H.K. & Macau only.**

watches.name: MICKEY I FANTASIA
watches.description: As we approach the 100th anniversary of Disney, UNDONE brings you good tidings from the land of magic and happily-ever-afters with a very special tribute: The Mickey Fantasia, inspired by Walt Disney’s groundbreaking 1940 masterpiece, a timeless classic that has inspired the imaginations of millions eversince, with its synaesthesia symphony of sights and sounds. Relive the magic with Mickey as the Sorcerer’s Apprentice- donning his master’s iconic wizard’s cap and robes, as he lights up the constellations across your wrist. **Exclusive to H.K. & Macau only.**

watches.name: UNDONE x Birdwell Beige Automatic
watches.description: As their 60th anniversary year comes to a celebratory end, the iconic surf apparel originators at Birdwell continue to expand their lifestyle offering with a collaboration with UNDONE watches. The capsule features a collector’s edition timepiece celebrating Birdwell’s iconic mascot “Birdie” with a black dial and tonal NATO strap. The UNDONE x Birdwell “Birdie” 60th Anniversary Watch is a harmonious balance of the watchmaker’s individualized approach to horology brought to life through the lens of Birdwell’s timeless California style and enduring quality.

watches.name: UNDONE Tinker Bell
watches.description: **The UNDONE Monochrome Collection** is an exclusive series of commemorative monotone collectibles. This crowning collection celebrates the brand’s best designs as well as unmistakable DNA as the world’s favourite “pop culture-infused horological Smorgasbord” in a monochromatic parade of superheroes and iconic characters. These special colour-washed “mods” are set to become the most desirable pieces in the expanse of UNDONE’s IP metaverse. We begin our milestone collection with the familiar frenemies: POPEYE Mono (300 PCS) & BRUTUS Mono (100 PCS).

watches.name: BRUTUS MONO Automatic
watches.description: **The UNDONE Monochrome Collection** is an exclusive series of commemorative monotone collectibles. This crowning collection celebrates the brand’s best designs as well as unmistakable DNA as the world’s favourite “pop culture-infused horological Smorgasbord” in a monochromatic parade of superheroes and iconic characters. These special colour-washed “mods” are set to become the most desirable pieces in the expanse of UNDONE’s IP metaverse. We begin our milestone collection with the familiar frenemies: POPEYE Mono (300 PCS) & BRUTUS Mono (100 PCS).

watches.name: UNDONE x Nicola Formichetti
watches.description: Known for conquering everything in fashion, Nicola has now designed his first watch in partnership with UNDONE. Nicola is an award-winning and acclaimed fashion designer, creative director, stylist, and editor. The fashion maven has held top design roles at Haus of Gaga, Diesel, Uniqlo, and Mugler. A cross-contamination of innovating and highly experimental design, created from highly sought-after elements such as carbon fibre, titanium, and sapphire crystal.

watches.name: Calavera Neón
watches.description: The Calavera Neón brings together the influences of José Guadalupe Posada’s legendary phrase and the deeply historical Mexican celebration. The striking dial is printed with fluorescent paint (as a reflection of the festivities’ bright colors), which is a first in UNDONE history, and is creatively designed with multiple colors that glow under black / UV light. The glass caseback features an inside look as well as a guitar-strumming skeleton coupled with Posada’s famous quote , “Todos Somos Calaveras,” which carries a deeper meaning to the way that life should be lived – underneath the surface of all our faults and differences, roles, and social status, we are but mortal living skeletons.

watches.name: UNDONE x Kevin Lyons Monsters Limited Boxset Edition
watches.description: UNDONE x Kevin Lyons Limited Boxset Edition is a colourful parade of Kevin's artistic vision. The dial is specially paired with a fluorescent pink second hand to give the watch that extra pop of colour. You will find all of Kevin Lyons’ monsters under one lens and enclosed in a 316L stainless steel case. The chronograph is fitted with a tachymeter bezel, the vintage inspiration is the perfect finishing touch for those amongst us who enjoy a fast-paced life. The UNDONE x Kevin Lyons Limited Edition is paired with a blue suede strap, silky smooth, the final touch for your indispensable everyday watch. The UNDONE x Kevin Lyons Limited Edition will be limited to 300 serialised pieces worldwide and will come paired with your personal Kevin Lyons monster mural (also serialised).

watches.name: UNDONE X POPEYE™ "Blacksand" Automatic
watches.description: This “Blacksand” edition highlights a left hand crown setup, a rare feature in a watch. It not only caters to “lefties” who wear their watches on the right hand, but also for those who wear watches on their left hand yet prefer the crown not intruding the wrist. Popeye™ himself stands proud in the middle of the dial in his well-loved gruff – one-eye squinting, corn-cob pipe tooting demeanour – with his comically muscular arms serving as the functioning hours and minutes hands. Surrounding the black dial is a bi-directional rotating bezel with beige diver function numerals to measure any time-related events. Complementing the watch is a 316L flat 3-link “Oyster” style stainless steel bracelet strap, complete with our signature quick-release technology, a rare but welcomed convenience for bracelets of this kind.

watches.name: UNDONE x STAPLE Yin-Yang Nato Automatic
watches.description: We’re taking storytelling to the next level by partnering with the highly creative streetwear pioneer jeffstaple of Staple Pigeon to bring you the UNDONE x STAPLE Yin-Yang Nato . This watch is designed to honor Jeff's heritage, life, and brand with a special reimagined Yin-Yang meets Pigeon design. The two interconnected pigeon heads emulate the Yin-Yang design. The quirky Cali Dial is distinguishable by the half-Roman numeral and half-circular hour-marker layout. A deeper exploration of the yin-yang inspiration brings together the bi-colored lumes. Staple’s motto “A Positive Social Contagion” is written along the bezel. jeffstaple has always been a big fan of the nato strap, which gives this piece its finishing touch - offering the most casual and streetstyle vibe.

watches.name: UNDONE x Simple Union: Urushi Automatic
watches.description: This watch is inspired by Urushi, a traditional art of Japanese lacquerware, and the craft of Maki-e, a popular centuries-old Japanese lacquer decoration technique of sprinkling precious metals such as gold/silver. ○ Black enamel-painted dial ○ Golden colored paint to emulate the sprinkling of powdered gold ○ Cali dial with four delicate grains of Kanji 「無」,「常」,「苦」,「空」

watches.name: POPEYE & FRIENDS 34 Olive Limited Edition
watches.description: The Olive watch is a simple yet elegant watch with the real mother of pearl (MOP) dial. It is a distinct beauty found in expensive watches, and exudes an elegance that befits a discerning watch collector. In keeping the dial clean and visually strong, the second hand has been removed so the dial can also be appreciated like a painting. This watch is limited to only 250 pieces, with every piece serialized on the watch caseback.

watches.name: UNDONE x Noritake Pointing Boy 2.0
watches.description: Working in a monochrome style with the occasional hints of blue and peach, Noritake’s beautifully expressed one-line illustrations still manage to evoke a sense of happiness in oneself. UNDONE has the privilege of working with Noritake for the second time, allowing you to wear his most loved illustration on your arm. The inspiration for “The Pointing Boy” stems from the combination of Noritake’s boy illustrations and giving the boy’s arms the possibility to tell you the time. The simple line work and timid smile often produce a slight giggle or humorous smile. This emotion is something that the artist wanted to give to the wearer of this piece, producing those extra smiles on your face throughout the day. Each watch will come with quick-release straps, delivered to you in a black velvet pouch and a special Noritake Box.

watches.name: ZEN CARTOGRAPH: FENG SHUI GRANDMASTER
watches.description: (Serial Numbered Limited Edition: 500PCS worldwide) “UNDONE” is proud to introduce the UNDONE ZEN [禪] CARTOGRAPH, a lab-tested, research-grade modern reinvention of the “Luo Pan” (羅盤), an ancient 4000 year old Feng Shui instrument used for the quantitative and qualitative measurement of “Luck”, now wrist-sized and perfect for your on-the-go surveying needs! Harness the perfect balance of light and darkness at the flick of your wrist with the spinning Yin-Yang seconds disk; Each unit includes with a comprehensive “Field Operator Manual”, say goodbye to bad karma and decision-making today with this sexy piece of equipment! Enter your birth year below and UNDONE will translate it to the corresponding celestial deity name printed on the caseback.
